title: Legal Officer - Micro LAP Documentation
description: We are looking for a Legal & Documentation Officer to support the Micro LAP business in legal document verification, property/ document scrutiny, loan documentation and legal due diligence . The primary responsibility of this role will be to verify and scrutinize legal and property-related documents submitted for Micro LAP proposals, identify legal/documentation gaps and coordinate with internal teams, customers, field teams and external legal counsel to ensure that loans are processed with proper and legally compliant documentation. The candidate should have a good understanding of property documents, title verification, legal due diligence, loan documentation and basic recovery/legal processes . Language Requirement Mandatory Hindi Read, Write & Speak: Mandatory Tamil – Read, Write & Speak: Mandatory English – Read, Write & Speak: Mandatory Key Responsibilities 1. Micro LAP Document Verification – Primary Responsibility Conduct detailed verification and scrutiny of legal and property documents submitted for Micro LAP loan proposals . Verify the completeness, validity and consistency of property-related documents. Review documents such as: Sale Deeds Mother / Parent Documents Title Deeds Encumbrance Certificates (EC) Patta / Chitta Adangal Property Tax Receipts Possession Certificates Building / Land-related approvals Legal Heir / Succession documents Partition / Settlement / Gift Deeds Power of Attorney documents Other property and ownership-related records. Identify discrepancies, missing documents, ownership issues, title defects and other legal risks. Ensure that documents submitted by customers are properly arranged and meet the prescribed legal/documentation checklist. Coordinate with external advocates / panel lawyers for title verification and legal opinions wherever required. Review legal opinions received from panel advocates and highlight observations or concerns to the reporting manager. Ensure timely completion of legal/document verification within defined TAT. 2. Property & Title Due Diligence Assist in conducting preliminary legal scrutiny of properties offered as security for Micro LAP loans. Verify ownership and title-related documents. Check for apparent encumbrances, competing claims, ownership discrepancies and documentation gaps. Identify potential legal risks affecting the enforceability or acceptability of the proposed security. Coordinate with panel advocates for detailed title search and legal due diligence. Follow up on pending legal reports and documentation deficiencies. 3. Loan Documentation Prepare, verify and maintain Micro LAP-related legal and loan documentation. Review loan agreements, sanction-related documents, security documents and other legal documents. Ensure execution of documents as per approved formats and applicable requirements. Verify whether required signatures, stamps, witnesses and supporting documents are in place. Coordinate with Operations, Credit, Business and Branch teams for completion of documentation before disbursement. Ensure proper filing and maintenance of legal documents and records. 4. Legal Query & Business Support Provide legal/documentation support to Credit, Business, Operations and Branch teams. Respond to queries relating to property documents and loan documentation. Highlight legal/documentation risks before loan processing or disbursement. Assist in resolving documentation discrepancies and deficiencies. Coordinate with customers and field teams for obtaining missing or corrected documents. 5. Legal & Recovery Support Assist the Legal team in recovery-related documentation and legal matters. Support legal notices, borrower-related legal correspondence and documentation wherever required. Assist in matters relating to cheque bounce, arbitration, recovery and borrower disputes. Maintain records of legal cases and documentation assigned to the team. Coordinate with external advocates and legal vendors when required. 6. Compliance & Process Management Ensure compliance with internal legal and documentation policies. Follow prescribed Micro LAP legal checklists, SOPs and approval processes. Maintain proper records of legal verification and documentation. Support internal audits and legal audits. Ensure timely escalation of critical legal/documentation issues. Suggest improvements to legal documentation and verification processes. 7. Stakeholder Coordination Coordinate with: Credit Teams Business / Sales Teams Branch Operations Risk & Compliance Collections Panel Advocates External Legal Firms Customers / Borrowers Ensure timely closure of legal and documentation observations. Preferred Candidate Profile LLB / LLM from a recognized university. 0–5 years of experience in Legal, Documentation, Property Verification or Legal Due Diligence. Fresh law graduates with strong knowledge of property documentation may be considered. Candidates with experience in Micro LAP, LAP, Housing Finance, NBFC, Banking, Mortgage Finance or Financial Services will be preferred. Experience in property document verification / title verification / legal scrutiny is highly preferred. Good understanding of property and land-related legal documents. Strong legal drafting and documentation skills. Good analytical and document-review skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to identify documentation discrepancies. Mandatory Language Skills: Hindi – Read, Write & Speak: Mandatory Tamil – Read, Write & Speak: Mandatory English – Read, Write & Speak: Mandatory
